entries.subject: Planck 2018 SMICA CMB map
entries.finding: The standard component-separated CMB temperature map (PR3, Nside 2048), sampled onto the planets' standard sphere (450 leaves) at the comoving distance of z* = 1089.80. The 2015 SMICA map at Nside 1024 (176 MB) was the smaller option; the 2018 release is the final one.
